rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a collection of gear, including a soldier’s loadout or equipment for a specific purpose.

example.english: I’ll pack a kit before setting off.
example.traditional: 我執好一套裝備先出發。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zap1 hou2 jat1 tou3 zong1 bei6 sin1 ceot1 faat3

rows.note: Use this for clothing generally; a sports strip is more specifically called 球衣.

example.english: This kit is just right for travelling.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 saam1 gei2 ngaam1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 zoek3

rows.note: Use this for a young cat rather than for equipment or clothing.

example.english: My friend has a kit, a young cat.
example.jyutping: ngo5 pang4 jau5 uk1 kei2 jau5 zek3 maau1 zai2

rows.note: Use this for a packaged set of parts that the buyer is expected to assemble.

example.english: You have to assemble this kit yourself.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 gin6 jiu3 zi6 gei2 cai3
